evidence.note: Wide white drawer immediately left of the stove is fully closed.
User's hand is pulling the drawer outward; contents have become visible.
Drawer is clearly open and remains extended.
User is pushing the still-open drawer inward.
Drawer is fully closed again.

events.object_description: Wide upper drawer in the white base cabinet between the refrigerator and stove

evidence.note: User reaches for the left door of the wall cabinet above the stove; it is still closed.
Left-hinged cabinet door is visibly open, exposing bottles inside.
Both wall-cabinet doors remain open.
User is manipulating the left door during the closing sequence.
Wall cabinet is closed.

events.object_description: Left door of the wall cabinet above the stove and range hood

evidence.note: Left cabinet door is already open while the user reaches toward the separate right door.
Right-hinged cabinet door is now visibly open; both doors expose the cabinet interior.
Both cabinet doors are still open.
Right door remains extended during the rapid closing sequence.
Right door is closed along with the rest of the cabinet.

events.object_description: Right door of the wall cabinet above the stove and range hood

evidence.note: User has grasped the top drawer handle in the narrow white cabinet to the right of the stove; drawer is closed.
Drawer is pulled open and its stored foil boxes, cloths, and utensils are visible.
Drawer remains open immediately before the closing action.
User is pushing the drawer shut and it is nearly closed.
Drawer is fully closed.

events.object_description: Top utility drawer in the narrow white base cabinet to the right of the stove

notes: Four distinct localized manipulation episodes are visible. The two wall-cabinet doors are counted separately because they are separate movable parts opened in successive actions. Their closing actions occur very close together between frames 544 and 560, so the exact ordering and midpoint of the right-door closure are less certain.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a wide food-storage drawer, separately opens and closes the two doors of an upper cabinet above the stove, and finally opens and closes a narrow utility drawer beside the stove.
